e2fgvi_dark_patch_proxy.definition: mean(mask luma) - mean(11x11 dilated ring luma); negative is darker

visual_assessment.logo_remaining: No clearly recognizable Veo letters in reviewed E2FGVI output frames.
visual_assessment.dna_continuity: Best of E2FGVI, TELEA and LaMa; moving cyan/DNA edges remain connected through the mask.
visual_assessment.flicker: Localized severe instability remains at frames 132-134; it is not uniformly distributed over the video.
visual_assessment.brightness_texture_wobble: Visible around 132-134 and as a subtle dark/soft texture imprint around 100-103.
visual_assessment.ghosting_double_edge: No persistent ghost or double edge found in the reviewed top-10 transitions.
visual_assessment.roi_seam: None before encoding; crop-boundary maximum absolute change is zero.
visual_assessment.abnormal_dark_patch: No flat black patch. Darkest proxy frames mostly follow genuinely dark source content, but a subtle local dark imprint remains in some frames.
visual_assessment.verdict: Not stable enough for Definition of Done or main-pipeline integration because the 132-134 temporal spike remains materially above the source transition. E2FGVI-HQ remains the strongest reconstruction-quality research baseline tested.
